A few questions:
This is mainly on the use of 'Spying Mission' (SM)

-Can I after i declare a action and another minion blocks tap 'the
barrens' in hope to draw some stealth ?
-In combat I have a blocking minion the oposing minion plays his strike
and now I have to make a strike, can I tab 'The Fragment..' in hope to
get a strike card I can use ?
What cards is there in the game has that 'card drawing' effect ?

> 2. If I bleed and the meth. beeing bleed has a 'Major Boon' in play

> pool can I then play sup-SM ?

Yes.

> 3. Can you play 'Major Boon' to take a bleed where there have been
> playde sup-SM

No. The bleed must be for 1 or more (card text on Major Boon).

> 4. Is there a time when I can NOT use master card in play' card drawing
> effects ? eg. the barrens, The fragment.., the sphinx....

When they are contested.

> To be precise:
> -Can I after i declare a action and another minion blocks tap 'the
> barrens' in hope to draw some stealth ?

Yes.

> -In combat I have a blocking minion the oposing minion plays his strike
> and now I have to make a strike, can I tab 'The Fragment..' in hope to
> get a strike card I can use ?

Yes.

> serpiente wrote:

> > Investigation can I the play sup-SM to cancel the AI ?
>
> No. Burned vampires cannot play Spying Mission.

I would like to add clarification to LSJ's post.
Archon Investigation can only be played when a minion ATTEMPTS to bleed for
more than 3.
The spying mission can only be played when you SUCESFULLY bleed. Since you
were burned, you did not bleed succesfully.
However, if you bleed Meth A for 2, and you also have a spying mission in
play, the spying mission does not trigger until you have succesfully bled,
therefore Meth A cannot play an Archon Investation.
<snip>

> > 4. Is there a time when I can NOT use master card in play' card drawing
> > effects ? eg. the barrens, The fragment.., the sphinx....
>
> When they are contested.

The Canonical Example being, if you have the barrens in play and Meth A
plays a Barrens, you CANNOT tap yours(to look for a sudden, etc). If
someone plays Sudden Reversal to cancel Meth A's Barrens, you could then tap
your Barrens, to say look for a sudden and then sudden the sudden and now be
contesting the barrens with Meth A. If you wanted to that is...

I hope this information helps you understand LSJ's posts more.

David Wilson(formerly Oros)

Presumably you could also tap to look for a Sudden because you thought
someone else might Sudden the Sudden so that you could reverse that
second Sudden and cancel the contest?

So if you are planning to Reverse a Sudden that was giong to cancel the
contestation of a Barrens, make sure that you ask th eplayer with the
Barrens if he wants to tap it before you play ;)

> LSJ said they can't be tapped when they are contested, which i took to

The Barrens is contested if another Barrens is played.
It cannot be tapped, even to look for a Sudden to save itself from
being contested.
